summary: The Trump-Xi Beijing summit wraps up today after two days of meetings, with markets digesting a deal that appears limited in scope — stabilization over revitalization. Tech and AI stocks drove equities to fresh record highs on summit optimism, but poor breadth signals the rally is narrow and top-heavy. Elevated real rates and a hot PPI print keep bond duration under pressure and gold sidelined as a safe haven.
tweet: Trump-Xi summit closes with a fragile trade truce — AI and tech carry stocks to records while the broad market lags, and hot inflation keeps bonds and gold in check.
